adds.name: saving exponent
adds.meaning: the fixed exponent $\kappa=2^{-182}$ by which the logarithmic factor is reduced

adds.name: stored volume
adds.meaning: the number of stored data bits of an array

adds.name: label dimension
adds.meaning: the dimension $m=h^3=10^6$ of the ambient label space, with ground set size $h=100$

adds.name: wire count
adds.meaning: the number of wires of the network under consideration

adds.name: rank sum
adds.meaning: the sum of the rational ranks of all edge differences of a network

adds.name: source dimension
adds.meaning: the total source dimension of a network, $N=v^3$ with $v=\binom{100}{3}$

adds.name: lost dimension
adds.meaning: the total dimension lost on decreasing edges of a network

adds.name: chunk width
adds.meaning: the number of bits in each of the two address chunks

adds.name: layer exponent
adds.meaning: the fixed exponent $\lambda'=1-2^{-54}$ for simultaneous layers

adds.name: axis count
adds.meaning: the number of transform axes, $d=\lfloor b^{\epsilon}\rfloor$

adds.name: chunk bits
adds.meaning: the number of bits in each address chunk of a layer, $K=\lfloor d^{c}\rfloor$

adds.name: radix digit width
adds.meaning: the digit width $b=\lceil\log_2 n\rceil$ of the radix-$2^b$ digits

adds.name: padded box size
adds.meaning: the padded box size, a power of two in $[4n/b,8n/b)$

adds.name: prime length product
adds.meaning: the product $S=\prod_i s_i$ of the distinct prime source lengths

adds.name: record length
adds.meaning: the number of coefficients in a polynomial record, $r=2^{\lceil(\log_2 T)/d\rceil}$
